text:
maria: quick UX ping 1: routing editor mock feels cramped on narrow viewports. left rail + canvas + right overview stack clips rule titles. screenshot: https://mock.redwood/dev/compact-issue.png

jon: agree. overview is fine on wide screens but steals vertical space when height is limited. could be a toggle or overlay. :thinking_face:

ashley: what about a single-line legend above canvas that expands into the full overview on demand? keeps essentials visible.

kevin: a11y: if overview is toggled it must trap focus and have `role=region` and an accessible label. also ensure the toggle is keyboard reachable.

sam: validation UX: preview shows ephemeral toasts for rule errors. users miss these. propose: small inline error badge on rule card + persistent toolbar banner until fixed.

maria: good call. also keyboard reorder: add "Move up"/"Move down" buttons that appear on card focus (visually hidden otherwise).

jon: include a context menu with "Move to top/bottom" for large reorders. move buttons should be announced by screen readers.

ashley: copy tweak: replace "Simulate traffic" with "Run routing simulation" and add tooltip: "Preview how traffic flows under current rules."

kevin: color contrast: error chips use mid-red that fails AA at 14px. bump to darker token and add high-contrast QA checks.

sam: visual nit: overview map re-centers during drag. freeze or throttle updates while dragging to avoid jank.

maria: next steps: ashley prototype compact-legend + expansion; jon annotate keyboard/context menu; kevin draft aria spec; sam add validation scenarios; i'll update mocks and post link.

design-bot: created task: "policy-editor: overview toggle + keyboard reorder + validation banner" (EPIC-3610).
